Initial release of phy-pipeline-contract-enforcer.

- Enforces data pipeline contracts by validating schema and business invariants at each pipeline stage boundary.
- Supports dbt models, Spark DataFrames, Pandas DataFrames, Kafka topics, REST API payloads, and raw CSV/JSON files.
- Can auto-generate contracts from data samples and validate samples against defined contracts.
- Detects schema drift and contract violations, with migration plan suggestions for resolution.
- Operates entirely via CLI and local files — no external APIs or services required.
